ddc.rawHTML:
208
Steady Hands
On Weapon Kill:
+100 Handling and 0.825x Handling Duration Multiplier for all equipped weapons for 8.5 ↑9.5 seconds.
Additional Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration to 6.5 seconds.
Buff remains active while stowed.
ddc.baseText: 208 Steady Hands On Weapon Kill : +100 Handling and 0.825x Handling Duration Multiplier for all equipped weapons for 8.5 seconds. Additional Weapon Kills refresh the buff duration to 6.5 seconds. Buff remains active while stowed.

policies.enhanced: 9.5 seconds excluded; no PvE/PvP split stated
policies.refresh: Source weapon paid final blows only; while active replace expiry with now+130, even when shorter; after expiry start170
policies.lifecycle: Original equipped count-one stack/owner/world/data/runtime/class/loadout/entry/selected exact tuple; ordinary stow retained
policies.timing: Raw Handling100; .825 ready/stow only, TD .9/.81, active Pulse .95, ready-only active Quickdraw .95, one ceil
policies.ads: Raw Handling100; no Steady/TD/Pulse/QD time scalar; exact Snapshot entry only .5 primary/.8 special
policies.incoming: Master selecting hook caches legitimate TD sample before incoming duration; no scans from getters

limitations: W46 Oracle May20 historical community curves and Oct13 official base stats are distinct snapshots; no current exact D2 duration claim.
W83/W84 additive exotic resources loaded by current WeaponExotics include Ace and Izanagi; no separate w121 file exists in this baseline.
Five sword curves remain unsupported; glaive ready/stow supported but ADS unsupported.
No armor/unknown exotic animation scalar or invented D2 current curve; existing positive raw stat contributors are redundant at100.
